scope: Three complete cached JATS introductions and their publication/history/permissions metadata; no remainder-of-article, PDF or NLP-parse review

selection.filter: Absent from frozen exclusion inputs; section in 650..1600 whitespace words; English research article, 2019 publication year, explicit CC BY link.
selection.order: Ascending raw_section_sha256; first three qualifying sections

reviewer: One assistant reading every selected introduction

reviews.section_boundary: Six complete paragraphs under the introduction heading; no figure, table, formula or footnote container in the selected section.
rendering_observations: Italicized gene/protein names remain distinct character strings when projected into plain text. Numbered citation links and ranges remain attached to their claims.
source_prose_findings: The title and parts of the introduction use Gly428Ser, while other passages use Gly482Ser. Preserve and flag this inconsistency; this review does not establish the intended identifier.
Several sentences use awkward agreement or relative-clause constructions, including the sentence linking the need for synthesis to meta-analysis. Their presence does not establish model authorship.
meaning_constraints: Retain separate power/endurance findings, study limitations and the qualified statement about the review's novelty. Do not make discrepant prior findings agree by rewriting them.

reviews.section_boundary: Eight complete introduction paragraphs; no figure, table, formula or footnote container in the selected section.
rendering_observations: Citation lists/ranges, parenthetical definitions and two opposed predictions are visible in the XML.
Single quotation marks identify terms and response labels such as one-shot, seen and unseen. These instances are not presented as externally attributed passages.
source_prose_findings: The phrase during the executing of the saccade is awkward in the source.
Scanning is used before the final paragraph explicitly identifies scanning saccades as a type of voluntary saccade. A later edit should preserve that subtype relationship.
meaning_constraints: Retain both opposed predictions linking reactive/voluntary adaptation to implicit/explicit learning, their separate theoretical rationales, and the stated purpose of resolving them.
Preserve the distinct gain-up/gain-down and awareness predictions, rather than treating all fast/slow learning contrasts as the same claim.

reviews.section_boundary: Seven complete introduction paragraphs; no figure, table, formula or footnote container in the selected section.
rendering_observations: Subscript receptor labels and italic species names occur despite the absence of formula markup. Plain-text rendering needs an explicit notation policy.
Citation brackets and ranges contain qualifications and counterexamples that must stay associated with the relevant claims.
source_prose_findings: The final paragraph leaves the parenthesis beginning after socio-environmental manipulation unclosed before the list of experimental methods continues.
The final sentence combines the plural subject results with the singular verb highlights.
meaning_constraints: Preserve the distinctions among species, sexes, receptor subtypes, behavioral intensity, contest duration and experimental context.
Keep uncertainty and exceptions: the source argues against a single uniform effect and identifies unresolved relationships.

shared_findings: All three cached permission notices explicitly describe reuse under CC BY 4.0 with author/source attribution. This is stronger evidence than a bare license link, but is not a complete item or dataset admission review.
The current JATS contains publication and submission/acceptance dates. It does not by itself establish that these exact bytes existed at that historical date.
No externally attributed verbatim passage was identified in the selected introductions during this reading. This finding covers only those sections and does not replace a whole-item rights check.
Human-reference candidates can contain conventional technical transitions, passive constructions and prose defects. Their label basis must remain separate from such stylistic observations.
No grammatical parse was executed or certified. The findings are manual readings of source prose and markup, with no detector-quality estimate.
next_action: Before admission, settle historical-version evidence, source attribution and related-text exclusions, then define a faithful citation/notation rendering policy and audit uncapped A-tokenizer lengths. Preserve source errors as observations rather than silently correcting them.
